title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. SOXX lost 12.7% over an eight-day losing streak (more than $1T of AI and chip market cap), Nvidia sits near $214 (~12% below its $243 Oct 6 record) and CoreWeave fell ~16% as its bonds yielded near 15%, even as TSMC posted a record quarter.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The constraint is financing, not demand: Anthropic reportedly told investors Q3 revenue was $16.8B (growth slowing to ~+50% QoQ), and Meta (Oct 21) then Microsoft and Alphabet (Oct 28) are the next capex reads.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tesla slipped to ~$374.5 ahead of its Oct 21 print, Nvidia reportedly weighs ~$1B more into Figure AI at ~$38B pre-money (unconfirmed), and South Korea approved a 20-robot humanoid factory sandbox.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Industrial demand is real (~603K installs in 2025, IFR sees 655K in 2026) but humanoid valuations still outrun shipments; UBTech admits Walker S2 reaches only 30-50% of human productivity.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Rheinmetall jumped 6.3% to €1,090 (~+20% from the early-October low) while drones sold off (JEDI ETF -5%, AeroVironment ~$122, -49% YTD) and Anduril opened a ~$1.3B employee tender at ~$90B.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is intact (Europe heading to 3.5% of GDP) but the continuing resolution to Dec 11 freezes 150+ new starts including Golden Dome.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. SMR stocks made fresh lows Oct 14-16: Oklo $27.97 (~80% below its high), X-energy $10.36 and Centrus -9.5%, despite Oklo's DOE Launch Pad advance and Amazon's 690 MW Calvert Cliffs PPA.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: No commercial SMR operates yet; long-term uranium holds at $97/lb but Oklo's ~$1B at-the-market programme keeps dilution in play. BWXT (Nov 2) and NuScale (Nov 5) report next.

sector_scoreboard.story: Energy Fuels cut to Avoid after a $500M at-the-market programme (shares -~10%) and law-firm probes. MP sits near $40 (~6% above its 52-week low), USAR fell ~31% in a month and REMX closed at a one-year low of $54.23.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: China's export-control suspension still lapses Jan 10, 2027 with the April 2025 licensing intact; lithium carbonate is down ~23% in a month while Chilean strikes hold copper near its record (~$6.53/lb).

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. SpaceX closed $148.62 (~34% below its $225.64 June high) after Starshield restrictions in Ukraine, Rocket Lab pushed Neutron's debut into 2027 (RKLB $55.25 after a ~21% six-session slide), yet Seraphim counted a record $20.8B of Q3 private investment.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: SpaceX reports Q3 on Oct 20 and the next lockup tranche follows Oct 24-29; the sector's capital intensity (Blue Origin's $10B raise, Rocket Lab's EBITDA loss) depends on funding staying open.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Fluence hit a new low of $5.80, Eos fell 15.7% to ~$1.82 amid five law-firm probes, and GE Vernova slid into a bear market at $921 (-23% from $1,193); Energy Vault raised FY26 revenue guidance.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Tesla (Oct 21) tests the energy margin (31.4% in Q2) after a 13.7 GWh Q3 that missed by ~14%; GE Vernova (Oct 28) tests its backlog thesis.

sector_scoreboard.story: Novartis and Schrodinger moved to Watch: NVS ($150.62) sits within 3% of its $154.65 target, and SDGR ($22.60 after an 11% drop) has no approved drug. XBI fell 3.7% on Oct 16 and Recursion dropped 17% after a $200M offering at $3.25.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: No AI-discovered drug has full FDA approval; Novartis (Oct 27), Illumina and Lilly (Oct 29) and Tempus (Nov 2) are the next checks.

sector_scoreboard.story: Quantinuum raised to a small Speculative position after Morgan Stanley's Oct 16 Overweight ($62 target) lifted it ~11% to ~$36.6, but pure-plays fell 10-22% on the week as IonQ announced a $2B equity raise and an all-stock Elisity deal (up to $1.3B).
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Sector revenue is ~$1.5B against multi-billion pure-play market caps; price-to-sales runs 54-419x and dilution is now the dominant risk.

cross_cutting_themes.title: One upgrade, three cuts: Quantinuum up; Energy Fuels, Novartis and Schrodinger down
cross_cutting_themes.description: Quantinuum (to Speculative) is the only raise; Energy Fuels goes to Avoid on a $500M at-the-market raise and law-firm probes, Novartis and Schrodinger to Watch on price versus targets and evidence. The pattern holds: good businesses, wrong prices.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Financing, not demand, is breaking the AI trade
cross_cutting_themes.description: SOXX lost 12.7% in an eight-day streak, CoreWeave's bonds yield near 15%, and Anthropic's Q3 growth slowed to ~+50% QoQ. Broadcom's and Intel's CEOs both flagged financing as the bigger constraint than chips or power.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Hot CPI sent the 10-year to 5.33%; it closed the week near 5.09%
cross_cutting_themes.description: The Nasdaq fell 4.5% on the week (ending a four-week winning streak) and the S&P 500 2%. CME FedWatch showed ~17% odds of an October hike and ~89% for December, so the Oct 27-28 FOMC carries more weight than usual.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Equity raises are the new bear case
cross_cutting_themes.description: IonQ's $2B raise, Oklo's ~$1B at-the-market programme, Energy Fuels' $500M and Recursion's $200M offering at $3.25 hit quantum, nuclear, minerals and biotech in the same week: companies are selling shares into weakness, and the market is treating it as a signal.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Oil above $100 adds a second inflation leg
cross_cutting_themes.description: WTI rose 3.4% to $101.35 and Brent 3.5% to $109.55 on Middle East risk on Oct 16; the energy sector was the S&P's best group while tech fell over 3%, complicating the rate path for long-duration names.

news_of_the_week.title: Hot September CPI sends the 10-year to 5.33%
news_of_the_week.description: Yields eased to ~5.09% by Friday, but the Nasdaq still lost 4.5% on the week and the S&P 500 2%, while the Dow gained 0.7%.

news_of_the_week.title: TSMC posts a record quarter, yet chip stocks fall an eighth straight day
news_of_the_week.description: SOXX is down 12.7% over the streak, more than $1T of AI and chip market cap; Nvidia sits near $214 versus a $243 record.

news_of_the_week.title: CoreWeave falls ~16% as its bonds yield near 15%
news_of_the_week.description: It fell another 12% on Oct 16; Anthropic reportedly told investors Q3 revenue was $16.8B, growth slowing to ~+50% QoQ, and IPO valuation talk has drifted toward ~$1.5T.

news_of_the_week.title: IonQ announces an Elisity deal and a $2B equity raise
news_of_the_week.description: Pure-plays fell 10-22% on the week; Morgan Stanley's Oct 16 Quantinuum upgrade was the lone bright spot.

news_of_the_week.title: SMR stocks hit fresh lows
news_of_the_week.description: Oklo closed $27.97 (-80% from its high), X-energy $10.36 and Centrus -9.5%, despite record long-term uranium prices and Clinch River's licence.

week_ahead.title: SpaceX Q3 results
week_ahead.description: First print since the June listing; the next lockup tranche (Oct 24-29) follows. Netflix, RTX and GE Aerospace also report.

week_ahead.title: Tesla and Meta Q3 (after close)
week_ahead.description: Tesla: consensus EPS ~$0.43 on ~$27.9B, with the Optimus and energy-margin reads. Meta: ~$6.35 EPS on ~$63.3B and the first hyperscaler capex update since the selloff.

week_ahead.title: Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Fanuc
week_ahead.description: Defense order books and Fanuc's AI Welding Agent and order trends.

week_ahead.title: FOMC, then Microsoft, Alphabet and GE Vernova
week_ahead.description: Markets price ~17% odds of an October hike and ~89% for December; Microsoft and Alphabet extend the capex read on Oct 28.

week_ahead.title: Lilly and Illumina Q3
week_ahead.description: Test of the AI-biotech compute-layer thesis after the Oct 16 sell-off.

stance_changes.name: Quantinuum
stance_changes.why: Morgan Stanley's Oct 16 Overweight ($62 target) rates its error-correction lead above IonQ's, but ~419x trailing sales and ~$8M quarterly revenue mean small size only.

stance_changes.name: Energy Fuels
stance_changes.why: A $500M at-the-market programme (shares -~10%) plus law-firm investor probes on Oct 14-15 put dilution and governance ahead of a still-unprofitable rare-earth ramp at $8.47, near the $7.81 low.

stance_changes.name: Novartis
stance_changes.why: At $150.62 it is within 3% of the $154.65 target (consensus Hold), it ended a lupus-nephritis trial Oct 16, and the week's $7.8B Abogen deal is mRNA, not AI.

stance_changes.name: Schrödinger
stance_changes.why: Even after an 11% drop to $22.60 it has no approved drug, and targets range from UBS $19 to KeyBanc $32 with Q3 on Nov 4.
